(HTTP 403)'. (2) Yes, it stopped after committing a6b7ca63 and before pushing or posting the attempt-2 receipt. Read from .process/tool/lib/job.mjs finish(): with again=true on a ready PR and the remote tip behind HEAD, it calls toDraft first (lib/github.mjs:51, the GraphQL convertPullRequestToDraft mutation), which 403s, so nothing after ran. I then pushed a6b7ca63 by hand (git push origin job/signatures). (3) Would a rerun get further? I did not rerun, as you asked. By the code: the remote tip now equals HEAD, so a rerun skips toDraft and the push, sees the newest receipt is at a different sha, and posts the attempt-2 receipt; pr.draft is false, so markReady is skipped. So yes, it would post the receipt. But the PR stays ready, never going draft and back to ready, so no new process-gate run on ready would be started to read it: the gate on a6b7ca63 would need re-running after the receipt is posted. The fix in the tool is toDraft using REST POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}/ccr/convert_to_draft. Say the word and I rerun job complete with the same flags.
